# Содержимое collector.py {#sec-ml-collector .appendix}

``` python
import sqlite3
import time
from datetime import datetime
from constants import DB_PATH


def collector():
    ts_current = time.time()
    ts_back_6h = ts_current - 6 * 3600
    weekday = datetime.now().weekday()
    slot = datetime.now().hour // 6

    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    cursor = conn.cursor()

    cursor.execute('''SELECT vpn_users.id, vpn_users.ip_addr, vpn_users.username FROM vpn_users
                    LEFT JOIN model_metadata ON vpn_users.id = model_metadata.user_id
                    WHERE vpn_users.ip_addr IS NOT NULL
                    AND model_metadata.model_path IS NULL''')

    users = cursor.fetchall()

    if (len(users) != 0):
        for user in users:
            cursor.execute('''SELECT
                            COUNT(*) AS total_conns,
                            SUM(orig_bytes),
                            SUM(resp_bytes),
                            duration,
                            COUNT(DISTINCT "id.resp_h") AS unique_dst_ips,
                            COUNT(DISTINCT "id.resp_p") AS unique_dst_ports,
                            AVG(duration) AS avg_duration,
                            (COUNT(*) / 6 * 60 * 60) AS conns_per_sec
                            FROM conn
                            WHERE conn."id.orig_h" = ? AND conn.ts <= ? AND conn.ts >= ?''',
                           (user[1], ts_current, ts_back_6h))

            userWindowData = cursor.fetchall()

            if (len(userWindowData[0]) != 0 and userWindowData[0][0] != 0):
                userWindowData = userWindowData[0]

                cursor.execute('''SELECT
                                COUNT(*) AS total_dns,
                                COUNT(DISTINCT query) AS unique_dns,
                                COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN rcode_name = 'NXDOMAIN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS nxdomain_dns
                                FROM dns
                                WHERE "id.orig_h" = ? AND ts <= ? AND ts >= ?''',
                               (user[1], ts_current, ts_back_6h))

                dns_data = cursor.fetchone()
                total_dns = dns_data[0] if dns_data else 0
                unique_dns = dns_data[1] if dns_data else 0
                nxdomain_dns = dns_data[2] if dns_data else 0

                cursor.execute('''
                INSERT INTO user_window_stats 
                (user_id, window_start, weekday, slot, total_conns, unique_dst_ips, unique_dst_ports, resp_bytes, orig_bytes, avg_duration, conns_per_sec, total_dns, unique_dns, nxdomain_dns)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
                ''',
                               (user[0], ts_back_6h, weekday, slot, userWindowData[0], userWindowData[4],
                                userWindowData[5], userWindowData[2], userWindowData[1], userWindowData[6],
                                userWindowData[7], total_dns, unique_dns, nxdomain_dns))
                conn.commit()

    cursor.close()


collector()
```
